# Trademark policy

> **Draft.** This policy is waiting for legal review and may change.

The Broccoli code is open source under the AGPL-3.0. The **Broccoli** name and
logo are not. They belong to Minari Limited and tell people that something
comes from us. This policy explains how you may use them.

## You may, without asking

- Say that your product or service uses, works with or is built on Broccoli,
  in plain text, for example "hosting for Broccoli" or "an integration for
  Broccoli".
- Use the name and logo to refer to the official project in articles, talks,
  tutorials and reviews.
- Keep the name and logo in an unmodified copy of Broccoli that you run for
  yourself or your own company.

## You may not, without written permission

- Use **Broccoli**, or a confusingly similar name, as the name of your
  product, service, company or domain.
- Sell, host or distribute a modified version under the Broccoli name or logo.
  Rename it and replace the logo first.
- Suggest that Minari Limited made, endorses or supports your product or
  service.
- Change the logo, or combine it with your own marks.

## Forks

You can fork Broccoli under the AGPL-3.0. If you distribute or host a fork,
give it a different name and logo, and say that it is based on Broccoli.

## Ask us

Not sure whether your use is allowed? Write to hello@getbroccoli.com.
